commission: Direct October 29 request for breaking-news artwork about faster machine taking third.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE NEW spectacular wide landscape 2:1 cinematic newspaper illustration for a breaking sports story: THE GIANT CAT HAS OVERTAKEN TURDUCKEN TO TAKE THIRD PLACE in the ARC-AGI-3 public competition. This is a new action episode, not a repeat of the previously published indoor arrival scene.
REFERENCE 1: exact xz cat owner-avatar identity. Preserve round flat cream/apricot face, very pale icy-blue eyes with dark pupils and slightly downturned lids, tiny pink nose, small ears and enormous fluffy white ruff, solemn slightly unimpressed expression. The cat is gigantic, three human heights high, with an enormous luxurious plume tail. Cat face remains fully exposed and clear, no goggles, helmet or human face. Natural fur and exactly four natural paws. Restrained charcoal/cobalt cyber vest with a few small GPU boards on the sides; most fur visible.
REFERENCE 2: authoritative Turducken character cast and mechanical bird only, NOT its hangar composition. Re-stage these EXACT seven distinct characters and TWO Yorkies together on the open broad deck of one brass-and-cobalt mechanical turkey, with a smaller mechanical chicken and duck visible in its service bay. Mark = muscular tattooed bearded cyber engineer, wide visor, gold chain. Son = separate smiling Asian cyber engineer with BROAD BLUE visor and dense black GPU headgear. Keith = little yellow mascot with black cap, NOT a human. DZ = blonde red-eyed chibi holding a pink bunny. NT = orange kitten in banana costume with comic tears, NOT the giant cream cat. Choryu = upright rectangular grayscale cardiac MRI-display head. Herminator = silver/cobalt knight with BLUE PLUME. Both small Yorkies have brown/black fur and ears upright. All seven crew must be separately readable, exactly two dogs, no extra humans.
NEW SCENE: exterior of GPU Valley at night, panoramic snow-covered mountain terraces, brass rails and monumental circular stone-and-copper podium platforms, violet-blue snowy peaks, warm amber light, fine flurries. The cat has just gracefully VAULTED PAST the mechanical turkey on a SEPARATE uphill track and is landing on the higher bronze terrace in the upper-left/middle of the picture. Giant fluffy tail arcs across the sky like a comet, displaced powder snow and warm light emphasize the decisive movement. Cat looks calm and purposeful, front paws planting on upper terrace, hind paws naturally following, recognizable face large in three-quarter view. It is moving PAST the turkey, never attacking or jumping onto its people. The turkey is on the lower neighboring terrace at right foreground, head turned up and left. Full seven-member crew and two dogs together look up toward the cat with astonishment, resolve and respectful sporting tension; no humiliation, aggression or danger. Mark and Son's faces are separate, clear, not merged. Crew can be arranged in two clearly separated rows along the large open mechanical bird deck so every identity fits.
CAMERA: low sweeping three-quarter view that makes the cat's ascent the unmistakable event; dramatic diagonal from mechanical turkey at lower right to enormous cream cat at upper middle-left. Rich tactile detailed brass, sapphire electronics, snowy stone, soft fur and painterly polished 3D-comic editorial style. NEW poses, outdoor setting, motion and camera. No scoring-hall screen or crack, no old interior scene, no additional named teams. Pictured machinery and scale are playful sporting metaphors.
LAYOUT: leave lower-left 31 percent width by 25 percent height as quiet dark snow/stone for an exact coded current-score panel; no face or paws in that corner. Leave upper-right 35 percent width by 13 percent height quiet dark sky for coded newspaper branding. Keep the cat face and all seven crew faces outside these graphics areas. Ensure all main characters visible at phone size. NO TEXT, logos, numbers, rank labels, dates, watermarks, trading-card borders or speech bubbles; all exact news typography will be added in code afterward.

references.role: Exact xz owner-avatar: round cream cat, pale blue eyes, pink nose and white ruff.
Seven established ARC3 Turducken characters, mechanical bird and exactly two Yorkies; identity reference only, new scene.
